## Technical details

### Block/CtaBannerShowcase

Use the ImageContrastOverlay component from <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-1">https://laioutr.atlassian.net/browse/THEMES-22</custom>.

Some props:

* headline
* subline
* cta text, href, size & variant
* background image & fallback color

    * This component only has one image-prop of type `Media`. No mobile image, no focus-point props.
    
* overlay props
* colors: default/always-white/always-black for all texts

[Styling for dark-mode](https://www.notion.so/laioutr/Tips-Tricks-for-development-1835331c061e801ab7d7c68ecfff9e5f?pvs=4#1a65331c061e803880f2eab02bfb4bb9)

Further props, specific for the showcase-banner:

* image aspect ratio desktop/mobile
* variant boxed/full-width (toggles container)
* optional caption
* text align mobile left/center

Pass `desktopBreakpoint="md"` to the Media component to ensure the mobile foreground/background-image is only used until md.

summary: A premium call-to-action banner for high-impact displays with large imagery and foreground/background layering.
features: Customizable image aspect ratios for desktop and mobile (16:9, 4:3, 1:1)
Foreground and background image support for layered presentations
Light and dark text themes with custom color override support
longDescription:
## Purpose

The CTA Banner Showcase component delivers maximum visual impact for premium promotional campaigns. It is specifically designed for product-focused presentations where large, high-quality imagery combined with compelling copy drives customer engagement and conversion.

## Use Cases

- Hero-level product launches showcasing new arrivals with layered foreground product images
- Seasonal campaign banners for major sales events like Black Friday or holiday promotions
- Brand storytelling sections featuring lifestyle imagery with prominent calls-to-action
- Premium product highlights where image quality and visual appeal are paramount

## Design Rationale

The flexible aspect ratio system ensures banners maintain visual integrity across devices while accommodating different image compositions. The foreground/background image layering capability allows for sophisticated product presentations where items appear to "pop" from the background. This component empowers marketing teams to create visually stunning promotions that rival custom-designed campaigns without requiring development resources.
